_comment: Daily quests (scripts/quests.gd). Every UTC day 3 different templates are drawn from the date alone (hash), so all devices see the same list and nothing needs the network. metric: wave = highest wave cleared in one battle (campaign or siege), kills = enemies killed that day, towers = towers built that day, upgrades = tower upgrades that day. targets: the day picks one by hash. key: translation key of the text ('%d' = the target). Rewards per slot: resources/economy.json (quests.rewards). Progress is counted from battle signals, never from the simulation.
